# Word reference export

1. Open `../edge-cases.docx` in Microsoft Word without repairing the file.
2. Keep tracked changes visible as authored and comments enabled in the
   document, but export document content without comment balloons.
3. Export all pages as PDF with standard quality and no manual scaling.
4. Save the result here as `edge-cases.pdf`.
5. Record the Word version, macOS version, export date, Office file SHA-256,
   PDF SHA-256, page count, and installed fonts in `reference.json`.

The PDF is ground truth. Never replace it with a PDF generated by this viewer,
LibreOffice, or a visual-regression update command.
